description: React component for managing model group aliases, including adding, editing, deleting, and displaying alias configurations with backend synchronization.

methods.name: saveAliasesToBackend
methods.description: Saves the current alias list to the backend via setCallbacksCall and triggers onAliasUpdate callback.

methods.name: handleAddAlias
methods.description: Handles adding a new alias, including validation and backend update.

methods.name: handleEditAlias
methods.description: Sets the alias to be edited.

methods.name: handleUpdateAlias
methods.description: Saves the edited alias to the backend and updates state.

methods.name: deleteAlias
methods.description: Deletes an alias by ID and updates backend.
